# Hotels Above Par

> > Hotels Above Par curates boutique hotels, luxury travel experiences, and design-forward destination guides across global locations from Austin to Cape Town.

Hotels Above Par (HAP) is a travel curation platform featuring the HAP Collection of boutique properties, Residences Above Par, and expert travel journalism covering hotels, restaurants, and cruise experiences. The site specializes in design-conscious accommodations and authentic destination guides across the United States, South Africa, the Bahamas, and beyond.
